versions.content: {DRAFT} For Synchronized Time Bases If • the Primary Virtual Local Time is not available • and Fallback Virtual Local Time is configured (i.e., StbMFallbackTime- Clock is configured) • and the Fallback Virtual Local Time is available, then the StbM shall set the current Time Tuple [TL, TV] with • TV set to the Fallback Virtual Local Time , • and TL set to the corresponding Fallback Local Instance of the Global Time calculated according to [SWS_StbM_00606]
